edges.reason: The selected source-path mechanism predicts abnormal generator-2 output.

The selected fluid-loss analogue predicts inventory decline from an observed reference.
Pressure can degrade as inventory/supply becomes insufficient; early retained pressure and subsequent restoration lag are allowed. No exact delay is assumed.
The represented net blue pressure-supply-path loss predicts degraded pressure without requiring inventory loss; alternate supply and component identity are not observed.

temporal_constraints.reason: For this selected depletion mechanism, observed inventory loss should not be definitely later than related pressure degradation. Overlapping/unknown onset intervals remain unresolved.

assumptions: Predictions apply to the supplied selected incident/epoch, not all aircraft systems or unobserved prehistory.
Within this finite catalogue, an effect unreachable from a candidate's roots is not explained by that candidate; a usable contrary observation rejects it.
Required effect absence is evaluated as observed absence in the current feature scope; candidates are reevaluated as evidence evolves, not permanently eliminated.
Conditional edges allow both retained and degraded downstream output; missing measurements never count as contradiction.
The independent and grouped candidates have identical observable signatures and temporal rules. No prior, complexity preference or initiating-event count breaks their tie.
Detector thresholds belong to the reused evidence layer, not this hypothesis model; no native depletion rates or fixed delays are fitted here.

The pressure extension covers a pressure-supply-only configuration and its source-path pair. Inventory-plus-supply and triple-root histories are not represented; this is not an exhaustive fault catalogue.
